latest_release.name: Synaplan v5.7.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs(planning): host the first-party plugins in this repository by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2987
* feat: add the phone settings hub and keep chat with the keyboard by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2976
* feat: mark AI conversations and generated media for the AI Act by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2990
* chore(release): install 5.7.0 in new deployments by @synaplan-release-tagger[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2986
* refactor: run the content-credentials signer inside the app container by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2992
* fix(chat): stop inventing a review command for file-only sends by @EKu26 in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2993
* fix: ask for a calendar clock time instead of inventing 09:00 by @EKu26 in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2996
* fix(deps): bump Symfony to 8.1.11 by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2988
* fix: run the app human check on the real site hostname by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2994
* fix: give generated media a source type c2patool accepts by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/2995


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/compare/v5.7.0...v5.7.1

detail.readme_excerpt:
Build AI assistants on your own documents and put them wherever work happens: web, WhatsApp, email, Outlook, Nextcloud and ownCloud. Mix local models with the best cloud AI, see what every answer costs, and decide what the AI is allowed to do – open source, on your server or ours. [**Run it in up to five minutes**](#quickstart)  ·  [**Try it hosted**](https://web.synaplan.com/)  ·  [**Docs**](https://docs.synaplan.com/)  ·  [**Discord**](https://discord.com/invite/kQB3eDjWfF) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/metadist/synaplan)](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/releases) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/metadist/synaplan?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join%20us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.com/invite/kQB3eDjWfF) Self-hosting is free. The hosted version opens with a paid plan or an invitation code – ask us at team@synaplan.com.

Chat, the cost of every answer, your files, generated media and connected apps – in about 30 seconds.

--- ## Why Synaplan - **Own your channels.** One assistant answers on your website, in WhatsApp, by email, in Outlook and inside Nextcloud and ownCloud – with the same knowledge and the same rules everywhere. - **Own your models.** Hundreds of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, sovereign EU providers or locally via Ollama. Mix them per task: sensitive work stays local, everything else gets the best model for the job. - **Own your costs.** Every answer shows its model and price. A planner splits bigger requests into steps and spends the expensive model only where it matters. - **Own the decisions.** Actions like sending mail or creating tickets wait for your approval, and every step is logged. - **Own the stack.** On-prem, EU cloud or fully air-gapped. No training on your data, no forced telemetry, no feature paywall: self-hosted Synaplan is the same software as our cloud, under Apache-2.0. **Running in production at** Megaherz Yoga · SANI Pflegedienst · National Secure Cloud · PlateArt --- ## Quickstart **You need:** Docker with Compose v2 and 8 GB of RAM. ```bash git clone https://github.com/metadist/synaplan.git cd synaplan make up ``` Open ****, log in as `admin@synaplan.com` / `admin123` and say hello.
